thread:
Alex (DevEx): hey team — quick sync about the new invoke playback surface i prototyped. goal: make run history + schema preview more scannable when you have long tool chains.
Maria (Design): nice, seeing the mock now. main thing: split-view keeps context but looks cramped. can we collapse the schema preview to a header strip?
Ken (Eng): collapsing would save vertical space but we need to preserve keyboard focus order. if header strip is collapsible, aria-expanded needs to be correct.
Aisha (Accessibility): agree on aria. also add "skip to current invocation" link for screen readers + keyboard users. right now there's a lot of repeated headings.
Rachel (PM): from product POV, the CTA should be clearer — "Replay from here" vs "Run from step". "Replay" implies only playback which confuses new users.
Alex (DevEx): good call. also thinking about infinite scroll in the run timeline. should older invocations be paginated or lazy-loaded? performance got worse on long traces.
Ken (Eng): lazy-load with a sentinel + skeletons is easiest. keep the active invocation pinned to top when you scroll to it. we can also expose a dev flag to limit prefetch tokens.
Maria (Design): copy tweaks: replace "show schema" with "Type & Output schema". tooltip: "Toggle to inspect expected inputs and structured output". shorter button labels help density.
Aisha (Accessibility): color contrast on the timeline badges is low at small sizes. increase contrast or add a focus ring for keyboard nav. also don't rely solely on color to indicate step status.
Ken (Eng): noted. will send a PR for the focus ring + role=list and role=listitem markup.
Alex (DevEx): replaybot test — @ReplayBot please replay step 3 of the example trace so we can test scroll/pin behavior
ReplayBot: /replay 3 — queued. will post results here once done.
Rachel (PM): one last UX ask: when you click a function def in the trace, open a compact inspector on the right, not a full modal. modal breaks flow when people want to scrub steps.
Maria (Design): agreed. compact inspector should show signature, sample input, and last output; button to expand to full editor.
Ken (Eng): ok i'll prototype the split-pane; will include keyboard shortcuts: `g` to go to current, `p` to pin, `r` to replay. any objections?
Aisha (Accessibility): please document the shortcuts in the help overlay and add an option to disable them for assistive tech users.
Alex (DevEx): thanks — i'll update the figma + add a small a11y checklist. follow-ups: ken to spike split-pane, maria to adjust copy, aisha to run quick keyboard/passive SR test. :thumbsup:
